_comment: Regression gates for the route's two models (lib/rut/models.ts). Primary, gemini-3.1-flash-lite: baseline 2026-09-27 after the NIT/DV prompt fix, two live runs: schema-valid 100%/100%, field accuracy 98.3%/98.3%, DV mismatches 0/0, p95 2.0 s/1.9 s (before the fix: 95.3-97.0% and 5-7 DV mismatches, NIT last-digit drops on image inputs). Fallback, deepseek-v4.1-flash (PDF page 1 rendered by pdf.js, as in the route): one live run, 100% schema-valid, 96.3% accuracy, 4 DV mismatches, p95 12.3 s; its DV gate holds the measured baseline, the target is 0.
